title: The parking gate state machine
prompt: Implement the `Parking` class: constructor takes the **capacity**. `arrive(plate)` adds the plate and returns true, unless the lot is **full** — then return false and change nothing. `depart(plate)` removes the plate and returns true, or returns false if the plate is not parked. `count()` returns the number of parked cars. Use an ArrayList<String>.

tests.name: gate transitions
tests.hint: arrive guards on size >= capacity; depart uses remove(plate) which already returns the boolean.
